Sound familiar?

You love your family fiercely. You’re also exhausted.

  • Dinner turns into a negotiation, and the same few foods are on repeat.
  • A small change of plan turns into a big meltdown, and you’re left picking up the pieces.
  • You’ve read everything and tried everything, and you still feel like you’re guessing.
  • The guilt shows up at night, after everyone else is finally asleep.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why a calmer home starts with a calmer you

Simple tools to settle your own nervous system, so you have more patience when it counts.

What to do in the first few minutes of a meltdown

How to respond with calm instead of panic, and what to say (and not say) in the moment.

How to take the pressure off mealtimes

A gentler way to approach new foods, so dinner stops being a daily standoff.

How to put down the guilt and shame

The thoughts that keep so many parents stuck in overwhelm, and how to start letting them go.

The three things I bring together with every family

Food, the nervous system and coaching for you, the parent, and how they fit together.

Before you grab your seat
